script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The claim that nobody is judged for someone else's actions goes beyond what this passage says about judging Israel according to its ways.
The line assumes the baker's neighbors are always watching how they live and stereotypes neighbors as nosy.
Panic instead of shouts of joy does not establish that the mountains are not quiet.
Comparing violence growing into a rod of punishment to rising cookie dough makes light of the violence and wickedness.
God tells the buyer not to rejoice and the seller not to mourn; the text does not say neither gets a reaction.
The text says the vision will not be revoked, not that it cannot be taken back.
The gadget taking up counter space does not match wealth becoming a stumbling block that brought iniquity, and the comparison trivializes that iniquity.
The explanation specifies one nation, while the text says the most wicked of nations.
The text does not say that the instruction and counsel disappear at the same time.
